events.headline: Oil prices climb as Iran threatens to restrict freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz while US sanctions/blockade on Iranian oil exports remain in place; diplomatic talks continue but no deal yet

US stock futures slide as 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007 (~5.15%) and 5-year yield tops 5% for first time since 2007, amid sticky inflation fears following the Fed's mid-September hike to 3.75%-4.00%

AMD tops $1 trillion market value, Intel +12%, Arm +17% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index notches a 5th straight gaining session as Meta's new AI agent ('Muse') fuels enthusiasm for AI chip demand

US-China trade truce extended to Jan 10 as Xi Jinping begins state visit to Washington; Treasury Secretary Bessent confirms tariffs stay lower and rare-earth mineral exports keep flowing, easing supply-chain/export-control risk
